summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of RLPC IT Assets Purchase Records app. All 27 pytest backend tests passed (config, CRUD, validation/enums, pagination with 55 records, search case-insensitive, individual+combined filters, date range, stats with filter, export xlsx/pdf magic-bytes, 404s). Frontend E2E via Playwright validated: app load, add flow with required-field validation, disabled purchase_date field, edit flow keeps date locked, cancel/confirm delete dialog, filter apply, XLSX+PDF blob downloads, toast messages, stat cards update.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: date filter comparison relies on lexicographic ordering of ISO strings; works for the '+00:00' TZ used at insert but could break if TZ-offset differences appear (e.g. '+05:30' vs '+00:00'). Consider storing as datetime type or normalizing to UTC 'Z'.
Minor: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('shutdown'); consider lifespan handlers.
Nit: PurchaseUpdate reuses PurchaseBase — cannot partially update. Full body required, which matches current UI behavior but is worth noting.
Frontend App.js download() uses raw axios (not the api base). It works because api.exportUrl returns the absolute URL, but consider using the shared axios instance for consistency.
seed_data_creation: Tests created TEST_-prefixed records and cleaned them up via teardown fixtures.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests are in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py and use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. All test data uses TEST_ prefix and is cleaned up. Frontend uses data-testids listed in the request; delete dialog uses AlertDialog; select options use 'option-purchase-<value>', 'option-mode-<value>', 'option-by-<value>'.
